name: The Princess Swap
source:
A chance meeting between a princess and a student who looks like her leads them to decide to switch places.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Princess_Swap]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一位公主和一位长得像她的学生的一次偶然相遇导致他们决定交换位置。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Princess_Swap]Choices Wikia[/url]]
